Implements: #2
Design: #3

## Summary
Implementation PR 1 of 6 for CR-2: the quality gate. Adds `scripts/quality-gate.sh` (dispatcher, design section 5), nine checks in `scripts/checks/`, a fixture-driven test script (`tests/quality-gate/run.sh`) that the gate invokes through a tenth check (`gate-tests`), and a minimal `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with the `quality-gate` job.

## Scope
Implementation plan section 3, PR 1: dispatcher; checks `bash-hygiene`, `shellcheck`, `public-repo-hygiene`, `workflow-policy`, `no-claude-in-workflows`, `links`, `yaml`, `markdown`, `actionlint`; one failing and one passing fixture per check; `ci.yml`. The `python`, `toolchain`, `ansible`, and `terraform` checks arrive with the code they check. This PR does not close the issue (only the final PR does).

Small deviations, none of which change a design decision:

- `gate-tests` (tenth check) is how "a test script the gate itself invokes" is realised. It runs `tests/quality-gate/run.sh` and is a no-op inside the tests.
- `scripts/lib/gate-lib.sh` (shared helpers) and two awk files (`workflow-policy.awk`, `links.awk`) keep the check scripts small. Each check declares `# tool:` and `# order:` headers; adding a check is still one file.
- Default file list is `git ls-files` minus `tests/*/fixtures/*` (fixtures are test inputs and deliberately contain bad content).
- `workflow-policy` also covers the AC rows C-6/C-7: it flags `workflow_run`, secret references other than `GITHUB_TOKEN`, a `paths:` filter under `on:`, and `permissions: write-all|read-all`.
- `public-repo-hygiene`: the OCID pattern is `ocid1.<type>.<realm>.` (not the bare prefix) because the merged design text itself mentions the prefix and cannot be edited here; token patterns need 16+ token characters after the prefix. Same intent, fewer false positives.
- A failing check outranks a missing tool: exit 1 before exit 3.
- Findings are sanitised (control characters removed, `::` neutralised) so they cannot forge Actions workflow commands.

## Acceptance criteria
All evidence is in `tests/quality-gate/run.sh` (94 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped locally; skips are listed below) and in the CI run of this PR.

| Row | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Q-1 | Tests `Q-1 exit 0 / 1 / 2` (unknown option, unknown id, `--base` without value or unresolvable, stray argument) and `Q-3` for exit 3 |
| Q-2 | Tests `Q-2 --list`, `--only`, `--skip`, `--base`; `--strict` in the Q-3 tests |
| Q-3 | Restricted `PATH` without `shellcheck`: `SKIP shellcheck (tool missing: shellcheck)`, exit 0; with `--strict`, exit 3; every tool-based check exits 78 without its tool |
| Q-4 | 30 seeded findings: 20 shown, `... 10 more (use --verbose)`, one summary line; `--verbose` shows 30 |
| Q-5 | `tests/quality-gate/fixtures/workflow-policy/`: `fail-unpinned`, `fail-tag-pinned`, `fail-no-version-comment`, `fail-pull-request-target`, `fail-no-permissions`, `fail-expression-in-run`, `fail-head-ref-in-run`, `fail-inline-expression`, `fail-curl-pipe-shell`, plus `pass-good` |
| Q-6 | `fixtures/no-claude-in-workflows/` (`fail-claude-comment`, `fail-anthropic-env`, `pass-ok`) |
| Q-7 | Generated at test time from fragments (nine failing cases: OCID, private and public IPv4, email, SHA256 and MD5 fingerprint, private-key header, `ghp_`, `github_pat_`); static `pass-ok` and generated pass case for documentation ranges, `0.0.0.0/0`, and `noreply`; a test asserts findings never echo the matched text |
| Q-8 | Tests: clean `git status` after a run, run under `env -i` (no credentials), run under `unshare -rn` (no network), static scan for network commands |
| Q-9 | Test with `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` (table appended, findings listed, existing content kept); CI run of this PR |
| C-1 | `workflow-policy` passes on `ci.yml` (top-level `permissions: {}`, job `contents: read`); fixtures `fail-no-permissions`, `fail-write-all` |
| C-2 | `workflow-policy` passes on `ci.yml`; pin evidence below. No container image exists yet (first one arrives with the `builder-profile` job) |
| C-6 | `fail-pull-request-target`, `fail-workflow-run`, `fail-secrets`, and the `no-claude-in-workflows` fixtures; the repository's own `ci.yml` passes both checks |
| C-7 | `fail-paths-filter`; `ci.yml` has no `paths:` |

## Workflow change justification
**What:** adds `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with one job, `quality-gate`. Triggers: `pull_request` (opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review) and `push` to `main`. No `paths:` filter, so the check can be required later without blocking merges (S1-7).

**Why:** ADR-003 section 7 and design section 7 put the quality gate in CI so results are read through `gh`, and the gate has to run on every PR.

**Risk and hardening:** top-level `permissions: {}`, job `contents: read`; runner `ubuntu-24.04`; `timeout-minutes: 10`; concurrency per PR; no secrets; no `pull_request_target`/`workflow_run`; nothing from the PR is interpolated into `run:`; the only Action is `actions/checkout`, `persist-credentials: false`; no Claude credential and no workflow that invokes Claude.

**Temporary state:** the toolchain (CR-2 PR 3) does not exist, so the job uses the runner image's tools. A missing `shellcheck` or `yamllint` would be installed from the image's package archive (the step is a no-op on the current image). `actionlint` and `pymarkdown` are neither on the image nor in its archive, so the job runs `--strict --skip actionlint,markdown` until PR 3. Both checks run locally (actionlint) or skip locally (markdown, tool missing).

**Pin evidence for `actions/checkout`** (read-only checks):
- `git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout`: `refs/tags/v7.0.1` is `3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1` (lightweight tag, no peeled entry).
- `gh api repos/actions/checkout/git/ref/tags/v7.0.1`: object type `commit`, sha `3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1`.
- `gh release view v7.0.1 -R actions/checkout`: published release, not a draft or pre-release, marked Latest (2026-07-20).

## Validation
- `./scripts/quality-gate.sh` on this branch (local): 8 passed, 2 skipped (`yaml`: yamllint not installed, `markdown`: pymarkdown not installed), exit 0.
- `shellcheck -x` on every script: clean. `actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml`: clean.
- `tests/quality-gate/run.sh`: 94 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped (yaml and markdown fixture cases, tool not installed). The yaml and markdown output adapters are tested with stand-in tools; no verdicts are faked. The `markdown` rule set (`md013`, `md033`, `md041` disabled) is untested against the real tool.
- CI (`gh pr checks`): `quality-gate` passes (run on the current head). It runs `--strict --skip actionlint,markdown`; the skipped checks are the two whose tools are not on the runner image. Its `yaml` check and the `yaml` fixture tests ran with the real yamllint 1.x from the image; the first CI run caught a comment-spacing rule (`comments`), fixed by allowing one space before a trailing comment. Q-9: the CI run executes the summary code path; I could not read the Summary tab through `gh`, so the table content is evidenced by the local test.
